definitions: Good Manufacturing Practice: A system for ensuring that products are consistently produced and controlled according to quality standards.
Guanosine Monophosphate: A nucleotide that is a fundamental building block of RNA and is involved in various metabolic processes.
examples: Adherence to GMP is crucial for pharmaceutical companies.
The facility received a warning for not following GMP guidelines.
GMP is an important component of RNA.
The enzyme catalyzes the conversion of GDP to GMP.
